description: This file defines the WorkWeekController class, which manages the rendering of the Work Week component in the OrangeHRM system. It prepares properties for the frontend Vue component, including localized labels for workweek day types.

classes.name: WorkWeekController
classes.description: The controller responsible for preparing the 'work-week' Vue component by setting day type properties with localized labels.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares and sets the Vue component with localized day type labels prior to rendering.

methods.name: getDataGroupsForCapabilityCheck
methods.description: Returns data group identifiers needed for permission or capability checks.
